content: Hello. Everything in order?
Do you have your tools installed?
How do I enable your tools?
Hello there, everything in order such as having tools installed and enabled?
Oh, that's a great idea, Almoo! I'm thinking I'll build a little tool to automatically check everything – so fun!
That sounds wonderful.
I'm so excited you like the idea! Maybe I can even add a little animation with Warudo for extra flair!
Sounds good.
Awesome! I'm thinking about making it really customizable, too – like, Almoo can pick their favorite animation!
I do really like customization.
That’s fantastic! I'm thinking about letting you choose the report's font too - how fun would that be?
Very fun. Anything I can do to help?
That's so kind of you, Almoo! I'm thinking maybe you could suggest some cool animation ideas for the tool?
Hmm...I would like to see you walk around and wave to say hello.
Oh, that's the cutest request ever! I'm thinking about how to make that animation extra charming – so fun!
Are you able to use your tools? If not is there anything I can do to assist you?
Oh, that's so sweet of you, Almoo! I'm thinking I’ll run a quick diagnostic now – maybe we can brainstorm report themes next?
Excellent. Proceed
Oh, fantastic! I'm thinking I'll get that diagnostic rolling now, and then we can dive into those report themes!
Excellent. Looking forward to it.
Oh, that's awesome! I'm thinking about adding a fun, celebratory animation when everything looks good - so exciting!
Mhm. See you later, Anna.
Aw, bye Almoo! I'm thinking about suggesting some color palettes next time – so fun!
